preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module WHERE name IN ('AccessionResults', 'StatusResults', 'RangeResults', 'PatientResults', 'LogbookResults') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Allow /result route by mapping it to core results modules used by the Results role
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module_url (id, url_path, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_url_seq'), '/result', m.id FROM clinlims.system_module m WHERE m.name IN ('AccessionResults', 'StatusResults', 'RangeResults', 'PatientResults', 'LogbookResults') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url existing WHERE existing.url_path = '/result' AND existing.system_module_id = m.id );
